content.title: Everything You Need to Know About Applying to Saint Louis University
content.text: Saint Louis University has an acceptance rate of 75%. Half the applicants admitted to Saint Louis University who submitted test scores have an SAT score between 1200 and 1410 or an ACT score of 25 and 31. However, one quarter of admitted applicants achieved scores above these ranges and one quarter scored below these ranges. The application deadline at Saint Louis University is rolling. Admissions officials at Saint Louis University consider a student's GPA a very important academic factor. An applicant's high school class rank is not considered but letters of recommendation are considered by admissions officials at Saint Louis University. To see additional academic factors along with other school data, learn more about College Compass.
